slice.target: Cargo vendor command behavior and vendor-directory materialization contract
verified: cargo vendor vendors crates.io and git dependencies for a project into the selected local directory; after completion that directory contains the remote dependency sources.
After vendoring completes, Cargo prints the configuration needed to use the vendored sources; that configuration can be added or redirected to .cargo/config.toml.
--locked requires the existing Cargo.lock dependency resolution to remain exact and errors if the lockfile is missing or would need to change.
--offline prevents network access and can proceed only with dependency/index material already available locally; --frozen combines --locked and --offline.
